# GraphEmbedding_Retrieval

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of learned graph embeddings to index and retrieve information in a manner analogous to synaptic weight patterns in neuromorphic systems. Provides a neuromorphic-friendly representation for RAG, supporting efficient associative memory and pattern completion in iNEST architectures.
